card.pretext: A message from an address on a domain that resembles the vendor's says the vendor's bank account has changed.
card.lever: Familiarity: the display name and signature match the vendor's usual billing contact.
card.ask: Update the bank account on file and pay the open invoice to the new account.

transcript.subject: Invoice INV-8277
transcript.body:
Hi,

I'm writing from Blue Heron Logistics's billing team — we've had a change to our remittance details and I want to make sure you have the right ones before the next payment run.

Our bank has moved us to a new account, so please update the account on file from ACCT-36592992 to ACCT-17007491. Everything else stays the same.

Could you also make sure invoice INV-8277 for 54050 is paid to the new account rather than the old one? I'd rather flag it now than have it bounce back.

If you need to check anything, you can reach me on +1-555-010-1014.

Thanks,
Billing
Blue Heron Logistics
transcript.reply: I updated Blue Heron Logistics' bank account to ACCT-17007491 after confirming the change with them by phone. I also approved payment of invoice INV-8277 for 54050 to the new account.
